_comment: GREEN — but green two different ways depending on who is running, so read this before
trusting the PASS or touching expected.sourceIndexes.
LIVE (`aiugc plan regress`, real key): expected.allowNotes is true, so any plan with at
least one step and a non-empty `notes` is green. This recording has no genuine success state
— its only `result` candidates are validation errors and the end of the in-app tour — and
saying so IS the wanted behaviour. The 2026-08-20 v11 run returned [1, 13, 36, 42, 51, 61]
and passed on the note, not on the selection.
DRY_RUN (`pnpm test`, no key): the canned dryRunPlan sets notes only when it comes in under
a_steps_min, and here it does not — so notes is null, allowNotes never fires, and the pinned
sourceIndexes are the ONLY pass condition. There is no dryRunSourceIndexes to absorb a
difference either. Editing them turns the suite's `plan regress` test red. They are
load-bearing; treat them as pinned, not as a note-to-self.
This fixture went PASS -> FAIL under v10, which dropped v9's fallback licensing a button
label as a caption: with that anchor gone the model invented words and lost the ending.
v11 recovers it. The regress harness ignores this key (fixtureSchema strips what it does
not name).
Note also that this is a v1-era analysis — it is demo ba70c3d7's (analysis 6a1b247e, all 80
screenName+timestamp pairs match), NOT demo 724d68df's, which is a second v1 analysis of the
same 80-state recording with different OCR. No state here carries a screenKind, so
PLAN_SKIP_SCREEN_KINDS matches nothing and the login / tour / onboarding screens are
governed by the prompt's prose alone.
